work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act commands the clergy and curial offices to walk in the Corpus Christi procession by the annexed rotulus, signed Placet GREGORIUS PP. XVI. (LF14457–14458), with its full rotulus through LF14729. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF14391; the printed form is undated. Own provenance note LF14412 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
